parsed.explanation: The dossier contains no trans-specific exposure at all: the only criminal law cited (sodomy/indecent-acts) was repealed in 2023, was never prosecuted in living memory, and is LGB rather than trans law; the marriage definition is a resident-facing non-recognition that only touches a trans visitor travelling with a same-sex spouse (no spousal standing, no recognition of a foreign marriage) — a narrow, low-severity friction. There is no documented presentation offence, border rule, facility rule, custody practice, police targeting, or violent incident, but also no documented trans-specific protection or acceptance beyond the bill's note citing growing LGBT acceptance. Given the thin record, no rememdy-risk and no cultural hostility documented, the small-population, recent-rights-reform setting means unknown facts should not be resolved into a severe penalty — I place it at the lower edge of reduced risk. Remaining uncertainty: no record covers border, healthcare or custody, and no positive protection is documented.
